question: What is the ratio of male to female patients among all those with abnormal uric acid counts?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "ua_with_sex" AS WITH sex_src AS (
  SELECT id_core, UPPER(TRIM(val)) AS sex_raw
  FROM table_1
  WHERE attr = 'SEX'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  t2.id AS patient_id,
  CASE
    WHEN sex_src.sex_raw IN ('M','MALE') THEN 'M'
    WHEN sex_src.sex_raw IN ('F','FEMALE') THEN 'F'
    ELSE sex_src.sex_raw
  END AS sex,
  t2.ua AS ua_value,
  t2.date AS test_date
FROM table_2 t2
LEFT JOIN sex_src
  ON t2.id = sex_src.id_core

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT patient_id, UPPER(TRIM(sex)) AS sex, ua_value
  FROM ua_with_sex
  WHERE ua_value IS NOT NULL
),
abnormal AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT patient_id, sex
  FROM base
  WHERE sex IN ('M','F')
    AND (
      (sex='M' AND (ua_value < 3.5 OR ua_value > 7.2)) OR
      (sex='F' AND (ua_value < 2.6 OR ua_value > 6.0))
    )
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN sex='M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_abnormal_patients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sex='F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_abnormal_patients,
    COUNT(*) AS total_abnormal_patients
  FROM abnormal
)
SELECT
  male_abnormal_patients,
  female_abnormal_patients,
  total_abnormal_patients,
  CASE WHEN female_abnormal_patients = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE CAST(male_abnormal_patients AS DOUBLE)/female_abnormal_patients
  END AS male_to_female_ratio,
  'Outside sex-specific reference ranges: M 3.5–7.2, F 2.6–6.0 mg/dL' AS abnormal_definition
FROM counts

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT patient_id, UPPER(TRIM(sex)) AS sex, ua_value
  FROM ua_with_sex
  WHERE ua_value IS NOT NULL
),
pats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patients_with_ua,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sex IN ('M','F') THEN patient_id END) AS patients_with_known_sex
  FROM base
),
abn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT patient_id, sex
  FROM base
  WHERE sex IN ('M','F') AND (
    (sex='M' AND (ua_value < 3.5 OR ua_value > 7.2)) OR
    (sex='F' AND (ua_value < 2.6 OR ua_value > 6.0))
  )
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sex='M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_abnormal_patients,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sex='F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS female_abnormal_patients,
    COUNT(*) AS total_abnormal_patients_known
  FROM abn
)
SELECT
  c.male_abnormal_patients,
  c.female_abnormal_patients,
  c.total_abnormal_patients_known,
  CASE WHEN c.female_abnormal_patients = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE CAST(c.male_abnormal_patients AS DOUBLE)/c.female_abnormal_patients
  END AS male_to_female_ratio,
  p.patients_with_ua,
  p.patients_with_known_sex,
  CASE WHEN p.patients_with_ua = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE CAST(p.patients_with_known_sex AS DOUBLE)/p.patients_with_ua
  END AS known_sex_share,
  CASE
    WHEN c.total_abnormal_patients_known = 0 THEN 'No abnormal-uric-acid patients with known sex; ratio undefined.'
    WHEN c.female_abnormal_patients = 0 THEN 'No female abnormal patients; ratio undefined (division by zero).'
    ELSE 'Ratio computed among abnormal patients with known sex.'
  END AS note,
  'Reference ranges used: M 3.5–7.2, F 2.6–6.0 mg/dL' AS definition
FROM cnt c CROSS JOIN pats p
